values: 一名灵活的刺客，能够躲进影子规避伤害，并对孤立目标造成伤害。
An Assassin excels at dodging damage by hiding in shadow and dealing damage to the isolated target.
为大家带来快乐是我的荣幸~
I'm honored to bring joy to everyone!
笑吧，闹吧，让世界——混乱吧！
Time for fun and laughs! Bringing chaos is a blast!
为这个昏乱的世界笑一笑吧？
*Yawn* Huh, who's there? Oh- it's me!
Wow, hahaha! Smile for this chaotic world!
哇哦，你听到了吗——混沌的呼唤！哈哈哈哈哈！
Did you hear that? The call of chaos! Hehehe!
惊喜！刺激！那些好玩的东西都去哪里了？嗯？
Surprise, excitement! Where did all the entertainment disappear to? Hmm?!
这可不是小丑的表演道具……那就摔碎吧！啊哈哈哈！
This isn't a jester's prop... let's shatter it! Hahaha!
Let's spice things up! Get things livelier!
Let's spice things up! Get things livelier!
I've prepared a surprise for you all!
Ah, the perfect night for a little harmless trouble!
贝利尔从不独断，他总会给人一些选项——“坏的”和“更坏的”。
Berial never acts unilaterally; he always provides people with some options - the "bad one" and the "worse one."
只要贝利尔愿意，他完全可以悄无声息，销声匿迹；但他坚持要热热闹闹地出场，为了“让事情更有意思一些”。
If Berial wanted to, he could disappear without a sound, but he insists on making a flashy entrance, just to "spice things up a bit."
据说，在深夜的小巷里独自行走，听到远处有逐渐接近的铃铛声时，千万不要回头——你会看到贝利尔的嬉笑。
It's said that if you find yourself walking alone in a dark alley late at night and hear bells getting closer, don't look back—you'll find Berial giggling.
耀光曾经有个很流行的恐怖传说：你的影子会站起来，模仿你，代替你。——贝利尔表示那并不是谣言。
"A spooky tale was once told that your shadow has the ability to stand up, imitate you, and eventually replace you." —Not just a story, according to Berial
过去有个村庄爆发了饥荒，而贝利尔给他们提供了两大块面包，为了欣赏人们抢夺的模样。
In a village hit by famine in the past, Berial tossed them two huge loaves of bread, just to enjoy the sight of people fighting over them.
贝利尔喜欢自由自在地模仿各种东西，但却厌恶各种固定了姿态的有形之物，比如说，神像。
Berial loves to imitate everything and everyone without restrictions but has a strong dislike for anything with a fixed form, like statues.
和尾巴一样，贝利尔的翅膀也是纯粹的装饰，他不需要翅膀也可以飞起来。
Just like his tail, Berial's wings are for decoration only. He is able to fly without wings.
贝利尔偶尔会在敬礼时把脑袋和帽子一起摘下来，以营造一些意外和幽默的效果，但好像大部分人只会受到惊吓。
Every now and then, during salutes, Berial takes off both his head and hat, aiming for some funny reactions. However, most people just find it horrific.
“邪魔之影贝利尔，它在月光下现身，浮动，犹如腐臭的地狱——”贝利尔本人认为这种世间的谣传纯属污蔑，因为他在白天也能现身。
"The shadowy mischief-maker Berial shows up in the night, drifting in like the foul smell of hell." —Berial calls it slander since he appears in the daytime as well.
贝利尔并不需要真正的影子才能现身，心灵的阴影同样是影子恶魔喜爱的土壤。

Berial doesn't need an actual shadow to appear. Shadows of the mind are enough. "All you need is a little darkness, and I'll pop right in and ruin your life." He giggled as he watched over an unsuspecting couple.
真是个好日子，对吧？是个非常适合做坏事的天气吧？就在这种非常不合衬的光天化日之下！
Lovely day isn't it? Perfect for causing mischief, am I right? Right in the glaringly unfitting sunshine!
Let's spice things up! Get things livelier!
I've prepared a surprise for you all!
啊——这里亮堂了不少，而且真够热闹的！
Ha! Look at this place—lit up like a bonfire party! So much chaos, so much life!
Ah, the perfect night for a little harmless trouble!
拉曼提斯！那座小城可是我精心准备了整整半个月的绝佳剧场！
Lamentis! Do you have any idea how much work went into that city?!
